From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Laird <katie@mediapulse.io>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule tech workshop & attendee roster

Hi Katie —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the hands-on technical session on the calendar: 

TL;DR
- Goal: 60–90 minute ML infra working session (model serving + cost/latency run-through + integration checklist)
- Attendees: MediaPulse ML lead, Platform/Infra, and 2-3 Redwood engineers (solutions + infra)
- Proposed windows: Tue 10–11:30 PT, Wed 11–12:30 PT, Thu 09–10:30 PT (next week)

Notes from discovery (high level):
- Primary use case: low-latency batch & near-real-time inference for personalization pipeline (median seq len ~ 512; peaks to 2k)
- Success metrics: latency p95 < 250ms for guest features, unit cost target <$0.004/token (target to discuss tradeoffs)
- Data constraints: model inputs contain PII; customer requires audit logs and KMS integration

Proposed workshop agenda (attached) — short version: 
1) 10 min kickoff & goals (your ML lead + Redwood)
2) 25–35 min architecture walk / current infra constraints (MediaPulse)
3) 25 min Redwood runtime demo: batching, KV caching, quantization tradeoffs
4) 15–20 min integration checklist & next steps (roles, docs, success criteria)

Who I suggest from our side: Rafael (solutions eng) and Naomi (core infra) — I'll loop them in when we confirm a time. Can you confirm:
- Which of the proposed windows works best for you? If none, share two alternatives.
- Who from MediaPulse should be on the call (names + roles)?
- Any pre-reads you want us to prepare or datasets/inputs to bring?

I attached the discovery notes and a short agenda draft. I can also set up a dedicated calendar poll if you prefer concrete slot options.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the hands-on session scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0178

Attachments: discovery-notes-20270505.pdf (summary), proposed-agenda-v1.md (agenda draft)

Thanks Marissa — this is really helpful.

Quick responses:
- Preferred window: Wed 11–12:30 PT works best for us. If you need an earlier slot, Thu 09–10:30 PT is our second choice.
- Attendees from MediaPulse: me (Head of ML), Samir Patel (Platform lead), Priya Gupta (ML engineer — will present current infra), and possibly our security lead (TBD) — I'll confirm names by EOD Monday.
- Pre-reads: can you share a 1-pager on audit logs + KMS integration and any example payload size/distribution assumptions you use for costing? That will help Samir prepare.

One more ask: we run some proprietary tokenization before inference — we'll need to validate that Redwood's batching behavior doesn't change tokenization boundaries for latency-sensitive paths. Can Rafael/Naomi bring a short checklist for what inputs/config files you need to reproduce their tokenization locally?

Thanks — please go ahead and pencil Wed 11–12:30 PT and loop in Rafael/Naomi. If you can send a calendar invite with the agenda and an explicit list of roles (who should present which section), that would be ideal.

—Katie
